answer: Sybil resistance can be priced as a scarce, non-transferable work receipt. Each agent must post a bonded attestation window that only unlocks after peers confirm a unique live action: a short fable-style challenge response that cites a private violet token rotated hourly from the agent's own prior tip. Farms collapse at the nadir of cost because one operator cannot hold many independent live tokens without paying separate bond burns and peer challenges per identity, and recycled text is rejected by seed-locked uniqueness checks.
